sharedFileOwnership.rule: writePaths are disjoint across the four dispatched plans and the accepted svc-p01, svc-p02, svc-p03 and svc-p07 paths. Every sharedPaths list is empty. Each plan edits only its own plan file and Progress Log. Workers must never edit: this manifest, the g1-g6 manifests, impl-plans/README.md, impl-plans/logs/**, or another plan's files. Workers must never run git checkout, restore, stash, reset, clean, commit, add or push. Per-edit discipline: read the file fresh before each edit; record pre/post SHA-256 hashes and an immutable intent snapshot under the evidence root; check for drift. If an owned file's hash changed outside the worker's own edits, write a Reconciliation request and never overwrite. Repairs after the wave join are serial.

reviewContext.userProblem: Inventory was extracted as a service but still called back into Telescreen for authentication, issue enrichment, actor names, assignee fallback, audit and retention delivery, and notification ran inside the main process sharing the caller transaction and main store. The owner wants Telescreen, Inventory and Notification each deployable as a microservice, with Inventory and Notification never calling Telescreen.
requiredOutcomes: Inventory serves all /api/data/* routes with unchanged responses and permissions from its replica, links and local audit chain, and dispatches overdue notifications through its own outbox while Telescreen is stopped. Eligibility, the command write, the audit entry and the acknowledgment happen in one inventory transaction.

telescreen-notification runs as its own process with its own store, inbox, delivery pump, templates, preferences, DLP prior-hit fold, replica recipients and audit chain. Telescreen and Inventory hold no SMTP/Slack credentials in split mode.
Every producer publishes NotificationCommands through a durable outbox, with deterministic ids and idempotent applied/duplicate/deferred receipts.
`telescreen notification-store copy|verify` dispatches to cli_inventory_store.run_notification (runbook step 4).
Multi-process TCP tests, restricted-login grants (integration), the leak matrix and the import gates pass. The rewritten tests/inventory_service/test_process.py runs and passes offline.
The 12 service-split tables sit inside their Nodetto frames after mise run ddl-arrange (serial finalization). mise run ci, ddl-check, web-ci and uv build pass.

designDecisionsAndRationale: D1 + C4: Inventory and Notification verify OIDC bearers and API tokens against a pushed directory replica via ReplicaAuthenticator, with error codes identical to api/common/auth.py.

D2: Telescreen publishes revisioned DirectoryEntity values (counters.directory_revision, only-if-newer apply, tombstones) through flush markers and a serialized relay; Inventory receives no email/slack fields.

D3: IssueLinkState and DirectoryUpdate are additive InventoryCommand kinds on the existing ordered outbox/inbox; the inventory applier receives them through injected sinks so telescreen.inventory keeps its import gate.
D4: producers redact inline text and context strings and send count-only ProducerRedactionHits; Notification folds them into DlpGate so verdicts match single process.
D5: per-store audit chains through AuditChainModels; Inventory drains its audit outbox locally; audit verify/export CLIs per service.

C1/R5 (design 8.4, run 7): /retention-status is removed; Inventory checks eligibility with telescreen.inventory.retention_outbox.retention_status in the same transaction that writes the notification command, reusing the obligation id as event_id for cross-cutover dedup.
C5: notifications/weekly.py moves to issues/weekly_report.py and stays a Telescreen producer.

Design 17 (run 7): the notification-store CLI dispatch is added in svc-p06 (cli.py routes to cli_inventory_store.run_notification); design 12: service-split Nodetto tables sit inside their frames, fixed in serial finalization.
intentionalTradeoffs: Replicas are eventually consistent: an unknown recipient within notification_replica_grace_seconds (default 600) is deferred with no writes; after grace it is recorded as SKIPPED recipient_unknown.

Five owner-review defaults (replicated API tokens, shared identity key, pending receipts, CLI audit path, two topologies) apply while pending in design-docs/user-qa/pending-service-split-tradeoffs.md.

supportedEdgeCases: Relay and concurrent API token revoke or issue status change (deterministic SQLite schedule; PostgreSQL two-connection variant marked integration).
Lost reply after applied command returns duplicate with no duplicate rows; reused event id with a different digest is a conflict.
Notification, Inventory or Telescreen stopped while producers commit; restart applies commands once and in order.

Superseded retention obligation produces no command and an overdue_superseded audit; owner fallback via issue link plus identity, then ownership rules team; a failed dispatch rolls back leaving no outbox row and the retention row pending.

Cutover: copied retention receipt makes the overdue command a duplicate; copied queued notifications without delivery state are seeded and delivered once; inventory transfer refuses an undelivered inventory notification outbox.
Setting only one service URL, or a single-process notification database URL different from main, is a ConfigError before any resource opens; notification-store copy with no notification URL exits 3.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Mixed topologies with only one extracted service.
